channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Morre mãe de Thiago Ávila, ativista detido em Israel
item.description: Teresa Regina de Ávila e Silva, mother of Brazilian activist Thiago Ávila and Sinpol-DF vice-president Luana de Ávila, died on Tuesday, May 5, 2026. Thiago Ávila remains detained in Israel since April 29 after participating in the Global Sumud Flotilla attempting to breach the Gaza blockade. Family and the Brazilian government are calling for his humanitarian release to attend his mother’s funeral.

item.title: TSE confirma decisão que negou transferência de domicílio eleitoral em Goiás nas Eleições 2024
item.description: The TSE unanimously upheld the TRE-GO’s decision denying electoral domicile transfers from Goiânia to Jussara (GO) for five voters. The voters failed to demonstrate sufficient personal, professional, or community ties to Jussara, despite claiming intent to work with a lawyer relative. The Court emphasized that domicile transfers require credible documentation proving current and effective links to the target municipality.

item.title: A estratégia da direita para recolocar Eduardo Bolsonaro no jogo político
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro has decided to back André do Prado as the PL’s Senate candidate for São Paulo, announcing he will serve as Prado’s substitute, in a bid to revive his political career after over a year in exile in the U.S. The move aims to bolster Tarcísio de Freitas’s re-election ticket and Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential project by leveraging Prado’s influence in the state legislature, despite internal PL criticism that Prado is merely Eduardo’s 'front man.' The party is now assessing how many votes Eduardo can transfer and the legal viability of the candidacy.

item.title: Universitários que vão votar pela 1ª vez ficam emocionados com visita ao TSE
item.description: University students from São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro visited the TSE on Tuesday night (5), just days before the final deadline for electoral regularization. Most were law students who will vote for the first time in 2026, praising the security of electronic voting machines and expressing emotion upon learning about Brazil’s electoral history, including a meeting with TSE President Minister Cármen Lúcia.

item.title: Motta diz que pautará nesta quarta projeto sobre terras raras e Planalto dá sinal verde ao texto
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced that the bill regulating the exploration of rare earth minerals will be placed on the agenda for this Wednesday’s session, with rapporteur Arnaldo Jardim having secured cross-party support and government endorsement. The bill, which has already received urgency status, authorizes the creation of a guarantor fund of up to R$ 5 billion to stimulate projects in the sector, with the federal government’s participation capped at R$ 2 billion. The Lula administration views the bill’s approval as crucial to strengthening Brazil’s position in upcoming negotiations with the United States, particularly ahead of the Lula-Trump meeting scheduled for Thursday.

item.title: Presidente do TSE reforça que prazo para regularizar o título termina nesta quarta (6)
item.description: TSE President Cármen Lúcia warned that the deadline to regularize voter registration ends this Wednesday (6). After that, the electoral roll will be closed to organize the 2026 General Elections on October 4. She urged citizens to visit electoral offices to obtain their first title, transfer residence, or update their data.

item.title: Casa Branca confirma que Lula se reunirá com Trump nesta quinta-feira
item.description: The White House confirmed that Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will meet with U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday, May 7, 2026, in Washington. This will be their second meeting, following a single encounter in Malaysia in 2025. Topics include economic cooperation, security, Brazil’s rare earth reserves, and the potential U.S. designation of Brazilian criminal groups as terrorist organizations — a move Lula opposes.

item.title: Lula levará a reunião com Trump proposta de acordo de combate ao crime organizado, diz Alckmin
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will bring to his meeting with Donald Trump a bilateral agreement proposal to combat organized crime. The meeting will take place this week in the United States. The initiative aims to strengthen Brazil-U.S. cooperation on public security issues.

item.title: TSE nega recurso sobre suposto abuso de poder político com viés religioso nas Eleições 2024 em Maragogipe (BA)
item.description: The TSE denied an appeal against a ruling that cleared then-candidates Valnício Armede Ribeiro and Adhemar Luiz Novaes of alleged abuse of political power with religious bias in the 2024 municipal elections in Maragogipe (BA). The Court found insufficient evidence that participation in the traditional 'Lavagem de São Bartolomeu' constituted an electoral offense, as the event is part of the municipality's official calendar and showed no misuse of purpose or disproportionate spending. The decision was unanimous.

item.title: Alerj defende no STF votação que elegeu Douglas Ruas presidente
item.description: The Legislative Assembly of Rio de Janeiro defended before the STF the validity of the election of Douglas Ruas (PL) as president of the House, arguing that the open vote does not violate the Constitution. The submission was sent to Minister Luiz Fux, rapporteur of a PDT action seeking to annul the election due to alleged exposure of lawmakers to pressure. Alerj maintains there is no grounds for judicial intervention in the state legislative sphere.

item.title: Casa Branca confirma encontro entre Lula e Trump
item.description: The White House confirmed a meeting between Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump scheduled for next Thursday, April 7, in Washington. The working visit will focus on economic and security issues deemed strategic for both nations.

item.title: TSE nega ação que acusava prefeito de Maragogipe (BA) de abuso de poder político em evento tradicional
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) denied an appeal filed by the coalition 'Experiência que Faz a Diferença' against the Bahia Regional Electoral Court's decision that cleared Maragogipe's mayor, Valnício Armede Ribeiro (PSD), and vice-mayor, Adhemar Luiz Novaes (PL), of allegations of political power abuse with religious bias. The accusation claimed the traditional 'Lavagem de São Bartolomeu' event was improperly used for 2024 campaign purposes, but rapporteur Minister Antônio Carlos Ferreira found insufficient evidence of abuse, noting that the appeal type does not allow re-examination of facts and evidence.

item.title: Pesquisa RealTime/Big Data aponta que 55% dos brasileiros não confiam no STF
item.description: A RealTime/Big Data poll shows that 55% of Brazilians do not trust the Supreme Federal Court (STF), while 36% say they trust it and 9% did not respond. Distrust is notably higher among right-wing voters, with 78% of Renan Santos supporters and 74% of Flávio Bolsonaro supporters expressing no confidence in the STF. The findings indicate a growing institutional polarization in Brazil’s political landscape.

item.title: Casa Branca confirma encontro de Lula com Trump em Washington na quinta-feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will depart for Washington on Wednesday (6) at 1 p.m. to meet with U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (7) at 11 a.m. local time. The meeting, described as a 'working visit', will focus on economic, security, Venezuela, critical minerals, organized crime, and PIX functionality, aiming to normalize bilateral trade relations after a period of tension.

item.title: ‘Nem tudo é céu de brigadeiro’, diz diretor da Real Time sobre avanço de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's rise in the polls is unstable and subject to setbacks, according to Lucas Thut Sahd of Real Time Big Data, who says his growth is not guaranteed. While he is technically tied with Lula in a potential runoff and benefits from the fragmentation of the right, Sahd warns that the campaign's start will bring backlash from opponents and that the economy is the central issue for voters.

item.title: O último dos fantasmas que ronda Brasília aparece a Lula nas noites insones do Alvorada
item.description: The text uses the metaphor of a 'ghost' to describe the disconnection of the Brazilian left, particularly the PT and Lula, from new realities of informal and precarious work, exemplified by a gathering of delivery workers in São Paulo’s Praça Charles Miller. It further identifies two other 'ghosts' haunting the government in 2026: the estrangement of the Armed Forces, which rejected bolsonarism without embracing petism despite far-right attacks on the military, and a deepening crisis between the political establishment and the Judiciary, with speculation of a potential confrontation at the STF in 2027, evoking the turbulent era of Floriano Peixoto. The narrative suggests Lula faces multiple crises of legitimacy and social connection.

item.title: TSE tenta se aproximar da população usando mascote sem gênero
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unveiled the mascot Pilili, whose name references the sound of the electronic ballot box when confirming a vote, during the event celebrating 30 years of electronic voting in Brazil. The character, presented as gender-neutral, aims to bring the population closer to the electronic voting system and make the process more accessible and playful.

item.title: Democracia à prova de extremos: como o TSE garantiu o voto em 2024
item.description: Under the presidency of Minister Cármen Lúcia, the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) overcame extreme climate challenges — floods in Rio Grande do Sul and drought in the Amazon — to secure voting for 155 million Brazilians in the 2024 Municipal Elections. Electoral Justice deployed backup ballot boxes and coordinated with Regional Electoral Courts (TREs) through a 'logistics of solidarity' strategy, ensuring the election proceeded despite environmental adversities. The minister’s administration also included preparations for the 2026 elections and institutional initiatives highlighted in the new TSE portal.

item.title: Cassação de Eduardo por faltas abre margem para questionamento sobre sua inelegibilidade
item.description: The potential candidacy of Eduardo Bolsonaro for the Senate as a substitute on André do Prado’s ticket raises questions about his eligibility, as his removal from office due to absences in the Chamber of Deputies does not fall under the two legal grounds that trigger ineligibility (breach of parliamentary decorum or incompatible business activities). Despite being self-exiled in the U.S. and losing his mandate after failing to renew a leave of absence, the law does not bar him from running, which is expected to prompt opposition challenges arguing his prolonged absence equates to resignation to evade censure.

item.title: Após atraso, Fazenda diz que sistema do Desenrola já está liberado
item.description: The Ministry of Finance announced that the operational system for the Novo Desenrola Brasil (Desenrola 2.0) has been released after implementation delays, allowing financial institutions to begin debt renegotiations tonight. Febraban explained the delay was due to technical adjustments in integrating bank systems with the Operações Guarantee Fund (FGO), a central component of the program. The regulation was published in the Official Gazette on Tuesday, the day the initiative was expected to be fully operational.

item.title: TSE lança campanha para incentivar candidaturas de mulheres, negros e indígenas
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched the 'Representatividade' campaign to encourage candidacies by women, Black people, and Indigenous groups, airing on radio and TV until July 30. The initiative aims to counter the historical underrepresentation of these groups in elected offices, emphasizing diversity as a cornerstone of democracy. It includes 30-second videos, radio spots, and social media content from the Electoral Justice, with the media plan available on the TSE Portal.

item.title: Alerj pede que STF rejeite ação contra eleição de Douglas Ruas
item.description: The Legislative Assembly of Rio de Janeiro (Alerj) has asked the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to reject a PDT lawsuit seeking to annul the election of Douglas Ruas (PL) as its president and to recognize him as the immediate successor to former governor Cláudio Castro, allowing him to assume interim state government. Alerj argues the election was fully constitutional, transparent, and in line with the current regime, rejecting claims that the open vote was unconstitutional.

item.title: Ministério Público também recorre ao TSE para cassar diploma de Cláudio Castro
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office appealed to the TSE to annul the diploma of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL), claiming an internal contradiction in the judgment's ruling, where ministerial votes allegedly favored cassation despite the final decision stating otherwise. Castro resigned one day before the ruling, creating uncertainty over whether his succession will be direct (popular vote) or indirect (via the state legislature), depending on the legal nature of the vacancy. The MP argues that upholding cassation would prevent 'rewarding' a procedural strategy to evade electoral misconduct consequences.

item.title: Lula autoriza adesão do Rio ao Propag, novo programa de renegociação de dívidas estaduais
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has officially authorized the state of Rio de Janeiro to join the Program for Full Payment of States' and Federal District's Debts (Propag), allowing it to exit the Fiscal Recovery Regime (RRF). The measure will reduce the state's monthly debt payment from R$ 490 million to approximately R$ 113 million, with gradual increases over five years, creating a potential monthly cash flow improvement of around R$ 1 billion.

item.title: Associação pede ao STF que declare nula rejeição de Messias no Senado
item.description: The Civitas Association for Citizenship and Culture filed a lawsuit at the STF requesting the nullification of the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, arguing for defect of will, abuse of purpose, and violation of constitutional due process due to secret voting and alleged leak of results. The group demands a new deliberation through open (nominal) voting, ensuring transparency, verifiability, and procedural integrity. The rejection on April 29, with 42 against and 34 in favor, marked the first defeat for Lula in a STF nomination in 132 years.

item.title: Fux vira relator de ação que questiona derrota de Messias no Senado
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux has been appointed as rapporteur of a legal action challenging the validity of Jorge Messias' defeat in the Federal Senate, following the rejection of his nomination to the STF. The petition, filed by the Associação Civitas para Cidadania e Cultura, argues that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's premature announcement of the outcome compromised the secrecy and authenticity of the vote, undermining senators' constitutional freedom of conscience.

item.title: À espera do ‘caos econômico’, um problema une Lula a Flávio na corrida eleitoral
item.description: The lack of concrete proposals and a mobilizing discourse explains the stagnation in the presidential race, according to columnist Robson Bonin. Both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro have failed to present a convincing national project, keeping the contest stalled. The current scenario favors Flávio due to his oppositional position, allowing a simple change-oriented rhetoric akin to Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 campaign, while Lula bears the burden of defending his administration.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro disputa Pix e Master com PT
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) rebutted a PT post on X linking him to the Banco Master scandal, claiming PIX was created under the Bolsonaro government and that Banco Master is tied to the PT and Lula. He denied any involvement and framed the accusation as a political smear. The exchange reflects rising pre-2026 election polarization.

item.title: Alcolumbre mantém posições no governo depois de derrotar Lula
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre, president of the Senate and National Congress, retained his position in the government after being identified as the architect behind the government’s double defeat last week. President Lula blamed Alcolumbre for orchestrating the legislative setbacks, signaling a deterioration in their relationship. Despite the tension, Alcolumbre did not lose his post, indicating a balance of power that shields him from immediate political repercussions.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa de evento dos 70 anos da Anfavea
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends the 70th-anniversary ceremony of Anfavea, held at the Martins Pena Hall of the National Theater Claudio Santoro in Brasília. The event highlights the association's seven decades of activity representing 26 automotive manufacturers in Brazil, emphasizing its significant role in job creation and national industrial output.

item.title: Senado aprova projeto que cria Universidade Federal Indígena
item.description: The Senate approved the bill creating the Federal Indigenous University (Unind), linked to the Ministry of Education, with headquarters in Brasília and decentralized campuses. The law mandates that the rector and vice-rector must be Indigenous, reserves seats and positions for Indigenous peoples through quotas, and includes programs in environmental management, health, law, Indigenous languages, and teacher training, addressing long-standing demands of traditional populations.

item.title: Governo é favorável ao projeto dos minerais críticos, diz Guimarães
item.description: The federal government supports PL 2.780/2024, which establishes the legal framework for critical and strategic minerals in Brazil, emphasizing industrialization, traceability, and national security. The bill includes tax incentives for domestic processing, creates an Executive-linked council with authority over exports, and sets up a R$2 billion guarantee fund to cover credit risks. It aligns with President Lula’s stance against exporting raw minerals and in favor of adding national value.

item.title: Segurança de Tarcísio retira vereador do Psol de evento em SP
item.description: São Roque city councilman Paulo Juventude (Psol-SP) was removed from a school inauguration event by the security detail of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas after protesting with a sign criticizing tolls and demanding 'Out with Tarcísio'. He claims he was violently approached by three officers, including municipal security advisor Alberto Malfi Sardilli, who immobilized him and twisted his arm. Three other council members were also removed but later allowed to return.

item.title: Senado aprova projeto que cria a Universidade Federal Indígena; texto vai à sanção
item.description: The Senate approved the bill creating the Federal Indigenous University (Unind), headquartered in Brasília with a decentralized model across Brazil, dedicated to higher education for Indigenous peoples. The university will offer programs in environmental management, health, law, agroecology, and Indigenous language promotion, with mandatory Indigenous leadership for rector and vice-rector. The text now awaits presidential sanction and is expected to begin operations in 2027.

item.title: Zema ironiza críticas da esquerda com meme sobre trabalho juvenil
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) shared a meme mocking left-wing criticism of his proposal to allow work from age 14. The meme features federal deputy Érika Hilton (PSOL) and deputy Guilherme Boulos (PSOL) with indifferent expressions, implying they overlook the reality of youth who need to work.

item.title: Dino dá 20 dias para governo Lula apresentar plano de fiscalização do mercado de capitais
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino ordered the Lula government to present, within 20 days, an emergency plan to restructure the capital markets supervision by the CVM, based on the collection of the supervision fee, prohibiting any surplus to the National Treasury. He also mandated a medium-term plan within 90 days, citing an 'unequivocal scenario' of institutional atrophy and budgetary asphyxia at the CVM, which facilitates fraud and organized crime infiltration, as seen in the Banco Master case. The ruling stems from ADI 7791 filed by the Novo Party, and President Lula must be formally notified of the CVM leadership vacancies, including the pending appointment of Otto Lobo, awaiting Senate approval.

item.title: Alerj pede ao STF que mantenha eleição da Mesa e rejeite ação por voto secreto
item.description: The president of the Rio de Janeiro State Legislative Assembly, Douglas Ruas, asked the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to reject a lawsuit seeking to annul the election of the House's Directive Board, held in April, and to order a new vote with secret ballot. He defends the validity of the current election and urges Justice Luiz Fux, the rapporteur, to uphold the result. The filing was submitted to the STF this week.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro oficializa pré-candidatura de André do Prado ao Senado; veja vídeo
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro officially announced André do Prado as his pre-candidate for the Senate under the PL party, stating in a video that he will be the first substitute. André do Prado, president of the São Paulo State Legislature (Alesp), pledged to defend amnesty for those involved in the January 8 attacks and the release of Jair Bolsonaro, acknowledging he will face a 'legal battle' to preserve the ticket. The announcement comes as Eduardo Bolsonaro remains in self-exile in the U.S., under investigation by the STF for alleged coercion in the criminal case against his father.

item.title: Acordo adia a votação do PL dos minerais críticos na Câmara
item.description: Leaders of the Chamber and the Lula government agreed to postpone the vote on the Critical Minerals Bill to Wednesday, keeping only the reading of the substitute text on Tuesday. The goal is to bring the bill to vote before Lula’s meeting with Trump in Washington, to strengthen Brazil’s position in the global race for rare earths. The mining sector requests more time for analysis, while critics argue the proposal favors large foreign mining firms without ensuring technological or industrial development.

item.title: Alckmin diz ser pouco provável nova indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin said it is unlikely that Jorge Messias will be renominated to the STF, lamenting the Senate's rejection by 42 votes against and 34 in favor, despite praising Messias as a dedicated public servant with legal expertise. He denied government failure in negotiations, attributing the outcome to senators' personal decisions, and noted that President Lula will consider other nominees, not necessarily the AGU. Alckmin framed the loss as a routine political setback, comparing it to losing an election by one vote and urging to move forward.

item.title: Haddad, em resposta a Tarcísio: situação em SP só não está pior por causa da ajuda de Lula
item.description: Fernando Haddad, pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo and former Minister of Finance, rebutted criticisms from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, who accused him of having 'broken the country'. Haddad responded that São Paulo's situation is not worse only due to Lula's federal support, defending the national government as crucial for state stability.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: comissão define cronograma e prevê votação no final de maio
item.description: The Special Committee of the Chamber of Deputies analyzing the end of the 6x1 work schedule has defined its work calendar: the report will be delivered on May 20, with a committee vote scheduled for May 26, and the proposal is expected to be taken to the plenary on May 27, as committed by Chamber President Hugo Motta.

item.title: Ibovespa sobe com alívio no petróleo, enquanto tensão externa segue no pano de fundo
item.description: The Ibovespa closed slightly higher at 186,757 points, driven by declining international oil prices, which eased inflationary pressures and improved global sentiment. Major banks such as Bradesco, Santander, and Banco do Brasil posted gains, while Itaú slipped slightly after releasing its quarterly results. Politically, the upcoming meeting between Lula and Trump in Washington is drawing attention amid a history of fluctuating bilateral relations.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro confirma disputa ao Senado por SP como suplente de André do Prado
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) confirmed he will run for a Senate seat in São Paulo as the substitute for André do Prado (PL), president of the State Legislative Assembly. He also announced Fernando Godoy as the second substitute on the ticket. Eduardo, who has been self-exiled in the U.S. for over a year, did not clarify whether he will return to Brazil for the campaign.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro anuncia pupilo de Valdemar para o Senado em SP: 'encaixa perfeitamente no projeto'
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro announced André do Prado, president of the São Paulo State Legislative Assembly, as his Senate candidate, backed by Valdemar Costa Neto and Tarcísio de Freitas. Prado accepted the nomination, committing to agendas such as amnesty for those involved in the January 8 events and defending Jair Bolsonaro, despite being in self-exile in the U.S. and facing potential ineligibility due to a STF case over alleged coercion.

item.title: Golpistas exploram fim de prazo para regularização de título do eleitor
item.description: As the deadline for voter registration regularization approaches (May 6), scammers are exploiting social media and messaging apps to defraud voters by impersonating electoral authorities with fake logos and threats of service suspensions. They trick vulnerable individuals into downloading unknown apps or sharing personal data and making payments, while the TSE and regional electoral courts emphasize that regularization is free and must only be done through official channels like the e-Título app, TRE websites, or in-person at electoral offices.

item.title: Tarcísio confirma Ramuth como vice em sua chapa
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas confirmed Felício Ramuth (MDB) as his running mate for vice-governor in the 2026 re-election bid. He also nominated André do Prado (PL) and Guilherme Derrite (PP) for Senate seats. Tarcísio criticized Fernando Haddad, his likely opponent, questioning Haddad’s fiscal credibility and calling for a 'red card' against the opposition.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro confirma que será suplente de André do Prado em chapa ao Senado por São Paulo
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro confirmed he will be the substitute for André do Prado (PL) on the Senate ticket for São Paulo, despite currently living in the United States. Governor Tarcísio de Freitas had earlier announced André do Prado as the candidate for the second Senate seat, while the first seat is held by Guilherme Derrite (PP). Eduardo’s candidacy as a substitute carries legal risks due to his mandate being cassated for excessive absences and an ongoing criminal case in the STF for coercion in the course of proceedings, which could render him ineligible if convicted by August 15.

item.title: É #FAKE que vídeo mostre polícia achando 'fábrica de cliques' de Flávio Bolsonaro e Nikolas Ferreira; imagens foram criadas com IA
item.description: A fabricated video claiming police discovered a 'click farm' linked to Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira was created using AI and has circulated since 2025. The politicians' press offices denied any involvement in such police operations, and the content had previously been debunked by Fato ou Fake.

item.title: Douglas Ruas defende votação aberta em recurso que pede ao STF que rejeite ação contra eleição da Mesa da Alerj
item.description: Douglas Ruas, president of the Alerj, urged the STF to dismiss a lawsuit seeking to annul the open vote for the Mesa Diretora, arguing that the voting model complies with Constitutional Amendment 76/2013 and constitutes an internal legislative matter beyond judicial review. He claims the action is inadmissible due to prior proceedings in the TJ-RJ and that transparency in voting is now the constitutional standard.
